description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated athlete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the athlete profile object (id, username, firstname, lastname, city, state, country, sex, premium, weight, ftp, follower_count, friend_count, created_at).

description: List the authenticated athlete's activities, sorted newest first, with optional time-window filtering and pagination.

before.description: Optional unix epoch (seconds); only activities starting at or before this time are returned.

after.description: Optional unix epoch (seconds); only activities starting at or after this time are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of activity objects.

description: Get aggregate run, ride, and swim totals for an athlete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has all_run_totals, all_ride_totals, and all_swim_totals; on failure (athlete not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single activity by its id.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the activity object with an embedded athlete reference; on failure (activity not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update the name and/or type of an existing activity.

activity_id.description: The id of the activity to update.

name.description: Optional new name for the activity.

type.description: Optional new activity type (also updates sport_type).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated activity object; on failure (activity not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the athletes who gave kudos to an activity.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of kudoers (firstname, lastname); on failure (activity not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single segment by its id.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the segment object; on failure (segment not found), output contains an error message.
